senses.gloss: --the flesh of the hare, good for श्राद्ध. M. १७. ३३.
--the animal fit for श्राद्ध purposes. वा. ८८. १३.
--the line of शशबिन्दु; performed अश्वमेधस्. Br. III. ७४. २६९; M. २७३. ७३.

(I) (चित्ररथ)--a son of Citraratha; highly learned and a yogin; an emperor of glory; had ten thousand wives and thousands of sons of whom six were distinguished. Possessed fourteen excellent jewels. His daughter Bin- दुमती (चैत्ररथी) had १०० famous sons with names begin- ning with पृथु;
1: भा. IX. २३. ३१-33; 6. ३८; Br. III. ७०. १९-22; M. ४४. १८-19; वा. ८८. ७०; ९५. १८-21.
father-in-law of मान्धाता; heard of the significance of श्राद्ध from Yama.
2: Br. III. १८. 1 and १५; ६३. ७०.
(II)--the moon. वा. ८२. 1.
--the Moon God; see Soma. M. १५०. ५३.
(I)--a son of Andhaka. M. ४४. ६१. [page३-396+ २९]
--a कला of the moon. Br. IV. ३५. ९२.
--a son of Citraratha; lord of १४ maha1ratnas and cakravarti; had १००,000 wives and ten lakhs of sons, among whom the chief were पृथुश्रव, पृथुकर्म and four others; (see शशबिन्दु). Vi. IV. १२. 3-6.
--the region of the moon, १००,000 yoja- nas from that of the sun; above it is the नक्षत्र man2d2alam. Vi. II. 7. 5-6.
--of the south. वा. ४५. १३०.
--a Tripravara. M. १९६. ३४.
--one of the eleven Rudras. M. १५३. १९. [page३-414+ २४]
(I)--a son of शिव and शक्ति, born of churning of ocean, see महाशास्त. Br. IV. 6. 9.
(II)--one of the eleven Rudras. M. १५३. १९.
--sciences of which पुराण is the first; recalled by ब्रह्मा. M. 3. 3; १८४. ४३; २४५. ८७; वा. ३०. 7; ५७-12.
--one-sixth of their merit the Brahmans give to righteous kings. भा. V. १५. ११.
--sacred to ललिता pi1t2ha. Br. IV. ४४. ९८.
--a sage of the Auttama epoch. M. 9. १४.
